exposure: Use of the insulin-only configuration of the iLet bionic pancreas (BP)
outcome: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) metrics (time in range 70-180 mg/dL, mean glucose, time <70 mg/dL, time <54 mg/dL)
cohort: The study included 90 adults and children (age 6-71 years) with type 1 diabetes who had previously completed the standard-of-care arm of the Insulin-Only BP Pivotal Trial.
finding: Glycemic control significantly improved after participants with type 1 diabetes transitioned from standard-of-care to using the insulin-only bionic pancreas, with mean HbA1c decreasing by 0.55% and time in range (70-180 mg/dL) increasing by 12.0% over 13 weeks.
